instruction: Insert miniature column charts in the Chart column (F2:F23) that display the three monthly values for each order ID.

metadata.explanation: This task requires inserting inline miniature column charts (similar to sparklines but using LibreOffice's mini chart feature). Verifying the presence and configuration of embedded chart objects within individual cells is not reliably achievable with standard openpyxl or similar libraries. Marked as infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: Correctly marked as infeasible: Embedded chart objects within individual cells cannot be reliably verified with standard spreadsheet libraries
Technical limitation is valid: LibreOffice's miniature column charts are complex graphical objects requiring visual verification or deep LibreOffice API integration
No feasible getter/metric exists: Current OSWorld framework lacks capabilities to extract and verify embedded chart objects from specific cells
Appropriate decision: This task requires cell-level chart object detection and configuration validation which is beyond file-based evaluation scope
